newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer PZU turns to profit in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer PZU turns to profit in Q1.

text.p: Poland's largest insurance company Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA (PZU) had a net profit of 205 million zlotys in the first quarter of 1997, against a 57-million-zloty loss in 1996, the firm said in a statement.
PZU said in a Monday's statement its gross premiums rose to two billion zlotys in the first quarter of 1997, from 1.4 billion in the same period of 1996.
It said its investments rose to 2.4 billion zlotys in the first quarter of 1997 from 1.5 billion in the same period of last year.
